label: D1 after a rewarded streak, early in episode, before choosing a2
explanation: Fires only at D1 and only when the reward input is 1 (100% of mass); never at GO/D2 or after an unrewarded trial, and essentially never when the trial two back was unrewarded (tv(reward,-2) != 0 also admits window-start trials whose history is unknown). Strongly restricted to early episode: trials 2-29 (none in trials 0-1, ~0 after trial 40), peaking at 3-19. Prefers trials where the agent is about to choose a2 (88% of mass; the upcoming choice is the agent own computation, so uses_future=false), equivalently a policy logit leaning a2 (choice in [-4.4,-1.5]) and a narrow value band (7.54-7.73). Previous-state S2 rewarded is a weaker variant (dev F1 0.59). Magnitude is tiny and roughly uniform across these conditions; the biggest activations come right after a rare-rewarded S2 visit that precedes a switch to a2. Dev F1 0.68 (P 0.57, R 0.83); firing within the condition is sporadic, so precision is incomplete.
